"Stream tile by tile" traces single-CTA one-pass recurrence: 3 KV tiles K, V (schematic 2 keys/tile; stored in shared 6-stack HBM, with which stack holds which bytes not specified) stream into the SM, multiply resident Q on the Tensor Core for scores, run Branch A (prior rescaling) in parallel with Branch B (weights P and row sum) before joining in place on the Tensor Core O←αO+P⋅VO \leftarrow \alpha O + P\cdot VO←αO+P⋅V, and divide once by lll after 1 sweep to yield o≈5.048o \approx 5.048o≈5.048. "Split into two segments and merge" splits the same 3 tiles across two parallel segment CTAs that independently write (oi,lsei)(o_i, \mathrm{lse}_i)(oi​,lsei​) into global-memory workspace slots wsA and wsB (which usually stay in L2) and exit; once all split CTAs exit so their writes are visible GPU-wide, a standalone merge kernel subtracts max⁡lse=5.52\max \mathrm{lse} = 5.52maxlse=5.52 (weight ratio 1:17/461 : 17/461:17/46, i.e., 46/6346/6346/63 and 17/6317/6317/63) to recover the exact same o≈5.048o \approx 5.048o≈5.048 (the timeline above shows event order only; bar width is not duration).
